Description: Petersburg is a historic independent city just south of Richmond, adjoining Fort Gregg-Adams (formerly Fort Lee), the Army's sustainment and logistics center in neighboring Prince George County. It offers VA medical-center access in nearby Richmond, Virginia's expanding military-retirement subtraction, and Walmart access, with home prices below the Richmond metro. Tradeoffs include a high crime rate, an economically distressed local government, and no local Costco.
